Demonstrated quantum-state control and months of storage do not mean an unchanged excited state for months. One part in 10 trillion is a prior electron benchmark; equivalent positron precision and a CPT comparison remain future goals. No discrepancy, energy source or commercial benefit was established. Electric and magnetic fields confine the particle, not gravity. General instrument-building and commercial analogies are analysis. Illustration is imagined, not hardware or particle evidence.
10月21日公告，五月预印本及八月v3更早。量子态控制与储存数月，不等于数月保持同一激发态。十万亿分之一是既有电子基准；同精度正电子测量及CPT比较仍是未来目标。未发现差异，也未证明能源或商业收益。约束粒子的是电磁场，非引力。仪器建设及商业类比属分析。插画为想象，非硬件或粒子影像。

Council negotiating mandate agreed October 21, text dated October 22; not an enacted replacement law. Proposed one-click refusal and at least four months concern repeat requests for the same purpose, not all cookies or communications. Conditional exemptions do not authorise unrestricted tracking. The proposed 96-hour high-risk breach deadline still requires no undue delay. National gateways differ from one EU portal. Existing privacy rights predate this proposal. Savings and behavioural effects are unmeasured.
理事会10月21日谈判立场、22日文本，非已生效替代法律。拟议一键拒绝及至少四个月，限定同一目的重复请求，非禁止全部Cookie或通讯。有条件豁免并非无限追踪许可。拟议96小时高风险泄露期限仍要求不得无故拖延。各国入口不同于全欧单一门户。既有隐私权早于本提案；节省及行为效应未获实测。
